scripts.eval: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 7000 --label "BASELINE (biasing prompt + fuzzy match)"
scripts.eval:v2: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 7000 --base-url http://localhost:8788 --label "FOUNDATION-V2 (no biasing, strict match)"
scripts.eval:fast: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 0 --label "BASELINE (biasing prompt + fuzzy match)"
scripts.eval:fast:v2: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 0 --base-url http://localhost:8788 --label "FOUNDATION-V2 (no biasing, strict match)"
scripts.eval:twopass: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 7000 --base-url http://localhost:8789 --label "E4 TWO-PASS (baseline + two-pass fallback)"
scripts.eval:fast:twopass: npx tsx scripts/run-eval.ts --delay-ms 0 --base-url http://localhost:8789 --label "E4 TWO-PASS (baseline + two-pass fallback)"
scripts.eval:repetition: npx tsx scripts/run-eval-experiment.ts --delay-ms 7000 --base-url http://localhost:8790 --experiment repetition --label "E1 REPETITION (say word 3x)"
scripts.eval:fast:repetition: npx tsx scripts/run-eval-experiment.ts --delay-ms 0 --base-url http://localhost:8790 --experiment repetition --label "E1 REPETITION (say word 3x)"
scripts.eval:frame: npx tsx scripts/run-eval-experiment.ts --delay-ms 7000 --base-url http://localhost:8791 --experiment frame_sentence --label "E2 FRAME SENTENCE (the word is X)"
scripts.eval:fast:frame: npx tsx scripts/run-eval-experiment.ts --delay-ms 0 --base-url http://localhost:8791 --experiment frame_sentence --label "E2 FRAME SENTENCE (the word is X)"
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run wrangler -- d1 migrations apply phonetiq-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run wrangler -- d1 migrations apply phonetiq-db --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run wrangler -- d1 execute phonetiq-db --local --file=./src/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run wrangler -- d1 execute phonetiq-db --local --file=./src/db/seed.sql
